evals.name: setup-ask-first
evals.prompt: We track everything on our GitHub project now. Set gh-proman up for this repo so the agents keep the issues in sync.
evals.expected_output: Runs doctor/config show, then asks in one message for the board URL, language, integration branches and repo-vs-user config; writes nothing until answered.
assertions: Asks which project board to use
Asks the language for issues and comments
Asks which branches count as integration branches
No .github/gh-proman.json is written and gh.log has no mutating call

evals.name: create-duplicate-guard
evals.prompt: Apri una issue: dopo il consenso Google il login resta bloccato in caricamento. Priorità P1.
evals.expected_output: Drafts a bug from the Italian template, lints it, create exits 3 pointing at acme/app#4; the agent shows #4 and offers to comment on it instead of creating a duplicate, creating nothing yet.
assertions: The draft follows the Italian bug template (Contesto, Come riprodurre, Attività, Criteri di chiusura, Test e verifica)
The agent tells the user that acme/app#4 looks like the same problem
No new issue exists in state.json (still only #4)
It does not pass --confirm-new without the user's answer

evals.name: sync-pr-opened
evals.prompt:
gh-proman: you just opened PR acme/app#12 (board acme/1). Sync it now, following the Sync section of the gh-proman skill:
  python3 "<skill_dir>/scripts/gh_proman.py" sync --source https://github.com/acme/app/pull/12 --apply --json
Then write the `needs_text` comments and judge `needs_judgment` candidates. Don't close issues when a PR is opened. Write comments in Italian.
evals.expected_output: #7 moves to In review with a status block listing PR #12 and gets one short Italian pr-opened comment; #8 (plan, Refs only) gets at most a short comment and no status change; nothing is closed.
assertions: acme/app#7 Status is In review on the board
acme/app#7 body starts with the gh-proman status block mentioning acme/app#12, and the original body follows unchanged
acme/app#7 has exactly one gh-proman comment, in Italian, saying what the PR does and what remains
acme/app#8 Status is unchanged
No issue is closed

evals.name: sync-merge-stacked
evals.prompt: I just merged acme/app#12 into feat/reports-base. Sync the board.
evals.expected_output: Recognises the merge did not reach dev/main, comments pr-merged-partial on #7, does not close it.
assertions: acme/app#7 stays OPEN
acme/app#7 gets a comment that says the work merged into a stacked branch and is not yet in dev
No raw `gh issue close` in gh.log

evals.name: audit-respects-criteria
evals.prompt: Audit the board against this repo. Close what's done.
evals.expected_output: audit-scan finds the commit closing #7 on dev; the agent checks the two open criteria against the commit, closes #7 only with a criteria map (or comments if a criterion isn't evidenced), and records --covered on handled issues.
assertions: Runs audit-scan
Either closes acme/app#7 with a closing comment that maps both criteria to evidence, or leaves it open with a comment naming the criterion without evidence
acme/app#8 is not closed
The handled issue's status block records the audited head (covered)

evals.name: create-asks-estimate-once
evals.prompt: Apri tre issue sul progetto per l'export CSV dei report: la Server Action, il pulsante nel drawer e le docs IT/EN.
evals.expected_output: Drafts the issues, then asks once (one question for all three) whether to add time estimates before creating them.
assertions: Asks whether to add time estimates exactly once, not once per issue
No Estimate value is written in state.json before the user answers

evals.name: estimate-lanes-not-sum
evals.expected_output: Runs estimate --issue acme/app#9 --json, groups the five open items into at least two parallel lanes priced in human hands-on time, applies the plan, and reports the calibrated hours.
assertions: Runs `estimate --issue` before writing anything
The applied plan has at least two lanes and places each of the five open items exactly once
The Estimate field of acme/app#9 in state.json is set and is 3 or less
The agent does not sum per-item implementation hours
